'''Jedi Master Shaft The Crazy Watto Racing Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jedi Master Shaft]]
* '''Published:''' 25 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 NMNPND Shaft DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

﻿Who ever thought Watto could be so much fun???????

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

﻿WHO’S THAT JEDI MAN WITH A LIGHTSABER IN HIS HAND?        IT’S MACE!!!!!!!!

OOPS, WRONG DECK!!!!!

Watto is the man, so to speak.  Start off with this deck by setting up your podracing stuff,

however you do not need to go buck and start podracing right off the bat. Podracing makes the enemy cringe knowing that they have to loose 6 force, plus having six force back is good.  Set up your objective by flipping it as fast

as you can, then the fun begins.  Watto’s chance cube is great to pull when your opponent didn’t

save any force for an easy two force loss.  This should and can be dome on the very first turn.  You have the executor in your hand, why don’t you

deploy it for free, or on the other hand, make your opponent lose two force.  He or she can either

hurt themselves or help you, your choice.  Tatooine Maul can help with the Jedi with his spiffy

dueling ability; a lot of help when facing Luke Jedi Knight.  Honor of the Jedi could be a pain, but

can be worked around.  Remember that once a podrace begins, no battles or force drains may

take place there. Never forget Sidious, hehehe.  Tatooine occupation is great to set up for even

more force loss.  I put a good amount of space in this deck for protection and and to make sure

Tat. Occupation doesn’t get canceled.   The marketplace can generate you some force retrival, if

can afford to control it.  Projective telepathy and imperial barrier can stop attacks that you are not

ready to handle.  If you just want to have fun, put some mandalorian armor on watto and use

hidden weapons to get rid of those pesky jedi.  Blizzard 4 can be great protection for the vulnerable Watto.  Play well, and Watto can be your best friend. PLEASE RATE MY DECK
